claim: A floor that travels or pans (a conveyor, a lift, a rotating ride) carries no decoration that is meant to stay put; a drain cover laid on a belt is wrong.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-18: 'there are few illogical things like that pipe entrance decoration on the conveyor belt instead on the floor'
use: Exclude movers from generic dressing passes; things that ride a mover are set carried (cstat 8192) on purpose.
